header.counters: perf_event_open, PERF_TYPE_HARDWARE cycles and instructions as one group on this thread, user mode only
header.go build: CC=clang CGO_ENABLED=1 GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly GOTOOLCHAIN=local go build -buildmode=c-archive -trimpath
header.method: 30 repetitions per (implementation, digest, length), each one loop of at least 20 ms, implementation order alternating ABBA, after 500 ms of warm-up
